title: pvCellCenters
body:
## pvCellCenters

Replaces each cell by a point at its parametric centre and outputs polygonal data; the input cell arrays become point arrays on those points. Use it to place glyphs or labels per cell, to probe or export cell-centred solver values as a point cloud, or as seeds. With VertexCells on, a vertex cell is added per point so the points render and count as cells. pvCoordinates instead keeps the mesh and adds centres as an array.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- The parametric centre is not the volume centroid for distorted or non-linear cells.
- Without VertexCells (ParaView default false) the output has points but no cells, which some later operations and exports ignore.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `CellCenters`. Identity: `filters/CellCenters`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the input to the Cell Centers filter. Accepted data: any dataset (meshes, grids, point sets) (vtkDataSet). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataSet"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `VertexCells` | If set to 1, a vertex cell will be generated per point in the output. Otherwise only points will be generated. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json

  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvCellCenters",
  "inputs": {
    "Input": "UPSTREAM_Input"
  }
}
```
